headline: A drift game where your EV battery is your health bar
text:
A drift game where grip is a budget and your EV battery is your health bar.

Real weight transfer physics, zero downloads, built in a single HTML file:
https://kreeda.games/drift/index.html

#gamedev #indiedev #webdev
mediaSuggestion: A 5-second looping gameplay GIF showing a tight countersteer drift around oncoming traffic during a rain biome transition, highlighting the green battery regen meter kicking in.
